description: This file defines the ProductOptionService interface for managing product options within the catalog, including methods for listing, retrieving, saving, and updating product options.

classes.name: ProductOptionService
classes.description: Java interface for product option related operations in the catalog system, extending generic service operations.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of product options for a given store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a product option by store, name, and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a read-only list of product options for a store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product option by store and option code.
